newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's BCP says BPA raising 85 bln esc.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's BCP says BPA raising 85 bln esc.

text.p: Banco Comercial Portugues said that its Banco Portugues do Atlantico unit would raise capital by 85 billion escudos.
BCP chairman Jorge Jardim Goncalves said in a statement that the capital rise would be carried out through issues of preference shares and perpetual bonds.
BPA's capital stands currently at 110 billion escudos.

BPA had already announced its intention to raise capital although the amount was not previously known. Although the bank is still quoted on the Lisbon bourse, there are very few shares still in circulation.
BCP has just over 50 percent of BPA with the remainder being held by insurer Imperio. The extraordinary shareholder assembly is set for February 18.

The statement said that the capital call would contribute "decisively to consolidate its financial structure at a stage in which the prospects for growth and the commercial dynamics are particularly positive."
It gave no further details of the call.
It added that given current market conditions, BPA could opt to pre-pay a 140 million ECU issue of convertible bonds made in 1992 on behalf of a Cayman Island subsidiary.
